assign.outcome:
**Columns resize, and two new width words** — drag any column's inline-end seam to resize it; double-click puts the page's word back. `width: "hug"` takes only what its rows need; `width: "fill"` takes everything left over.

![](drag-1920.png)

**Proven** (headless, the live [Finder](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/finder/) at 1920, the root `small` rail):

| gesture | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| drag right 150px | 224 | **374** — the move exactly |
| drag left 120px | 374 | **254** |
| drag left 300px | 254 | **96** — `Page.column_floor`, the clamp |
| double-click the seam | 96 | **224**, inline style empty again |

The row's `scrollWidth` equals its `clientWidth` at every step: **the seam costs the row nothing** (`flex-basis: 6px` + `margin-inline-start: -6px` = an outer size of zero, pulled back onto the column it resizes).

**The two words**, measured at 400/1280/1920/3440 — the full table is in [`doc/columns.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/columns/):

| | 1280 | 1920 | 3440 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hug` (the Finder's `Notes` rail) | 100 | 107 | 120 |
| `fill` | 420 | 1005 | **2410** |
| `large`, for contrast | 421 | 1005 | 1152 (its ceiling; 1258px left empty) |

`fill` is exactly `row - the rails`, and the row is exactly the sum of its columns. `full` and the five-deep nav are byte-for-byte the 2026-08-26 numbers. **Zero console errors, zero layout flags: 7 routes x 4 viewports.**

**Shipped** — [Page.class.js](/framework/core/Page/api/columns/) (`column_grab()`, `resize_column()`, `column_floor`), `Page.css` (`.page-column-hug` / `-fill` / `-grab`), [`doc/columns.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/columns/) (six words, the seam, the persistence question), [`doc/decisions.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/decisions/), the [Finder](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/finder/) (a `hug` rail, a `fill` column, a one-line label on arrival). Shots: [400](fill-400.png) - [1920](fill-1920.png) - [3440](fill-3440.png).

**Left, deliberately** — resize is **per visit**; nothing is stored. The three questions that have to be answered before it sticks (what owns a width, where it lives, how you get out of it) are written up under *Open* in `doc/columns.md`. No `ext/grip`: core must not depend on ext, and the gesture is `setPointerCapture` plus one `lostpointercapture`. No `doc/method/` pages for the two new methods - `column()`, `render_column()` and `reveal_column()` have none either, and `core/Page/page.js` (which declares that list) is outside this task's fence.
